name: German
notes: The most spoken first language in Europe — Germany, Austria, most of Switzerland, and understood across the north and centre of the continent. English is a Germanic language: hundreds of words are cousins (Haus, Wasser, Brot, Mutter, gut, kalt), the sounds are mostly familiar, and the spelling is regular. The work is in the grammar — three genders, four cases, and the verb that goes to the end of the sentence.
syllabus: About 375 words and phrases — the core of CEFR A1 (roughly 500 words): survival, the family, food, the house, the town, travel, a hundred verbs and the words that put a sentence together, with the grammar in the guide. Enough to be polite, shop, ask directions and say what you need. Cards can be spoken aloud if Windows has a German voice installed.
